input.summary:
P1 north-east bedroom lamplighting: a standing lantern at (26,6,16) lights all 9 floor cells (min 11, 0 dark) on a scratch copy, but the live build refuses it.
The ceiling at y9 is still air (no roof.json, so the roof part is skipped), so the hanging lantern is not available and the designer's barrel was never built.
The room is still dark (9 of 9 cells at 0) in build.nbt; make.sh runs whole.
left: The lantern call is in parts/room-15.mjs build(g) but runParts refuses it: the shell-west part locked this room's air cells (parts-report: room P1 north-east bedroom REFUSED 1 at 26,6,16 lantern/air). The room stays dark (min 0, 9 dark cells) until the shell leaves these cells unlocked or the lock admits lamps; that is shell-west's or runParts' change, not mine, so I did not touch it.

The designer's condition is unmet: roof.json is not written in this run, so the roof is skipped and y9 over x26..28 z14..16 is air. The hanging-lantern option cannot be confirmed. The roof part must write roof.json and then the y9 ceiling needs a re-check.

The designer's barrel nightstand is not built, so the planned standing lantern on the barrel (28,7,15) does not exist. I chose a floor-standing lantern at (26,6,16) on the oak_planks floor, which keeps the bed, chest, poppy and door lane clear. If the barrel is added later, moving the lantern to (28,7,15) is a designer call.
Confirming the light map from the real roof is still open: the roof must exist first.

waste.tool: mcd room should check first whether a lamp cell is writable under the runParts lock (report 'locked by shell-west: air') and print the ceiling block above each lantern spot, so a refused lamp shows before a rebuild

waste.what: Found the runParts air lock only after the lantern write was refused in the full build, the same failure room-1 documents
waste.cost: one make.sh run plus parts-report inspection
waste.tool: runParts or mcd room could flag, at the room's build step, that every interior cell is locked by the shell, so designers and lamplighters know the room is unbuildable before they write

waste.what: Check the MCD variable in zsh: MCD="node ..." does not word-split, so $MCD failed as a command name
waste.tool: A shell wrapper or the mcd bin on PATH would avoid word-splitting problems across shells
